blocks.h2: Water Heater Installation Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: What size water heater does a large home need?
items.preview: It depends on your peak use.
items.answer: It depends on how many showers and tubs run at once. Larger homes often need 75 gallons or more, two heaters or a tankless system. We'll size it to your household.

items.q: Can you add a hot water recirculation system?
items.answer: Yes. A recirculation pump brings hot water to distant fixtures faster, which helps in larger homes.
A standard replacement takes a few hours. Switching types or venting takes longer.

items.q: Do you remove the old water heater?
items.answer: Yes. We drain it, disconnect it and haul it away.

items.q: Can we move the water heater to a different spot?
items.answer: Often. Moving it means new water, gas and venting connections. We'll tell you what's involved.

items.q: Can you add a recirculation pump with a new heater?
items.answer: Yes. It brings hot water to faraway fixtures faster.

items.q: How much does water heater replacement cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on size, type and venting. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the size, fuel type, venting and any code updates. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
